lake county official events calendar|202.title: Lake County Official Events Calendar
lake county official events calendar|202.description: Ongoing county events calendar listing community and cultural events across Lake County (Antioch, Deerfield, Fox Lake, Grayslake, Gurnee, Highland Park, Waukegan, Zion, etc.).

lake county beach monitoring & advisorie.title: Lake County Beach Monitoring & Advisories (seasonal)
lake county beach monitoring & advisorie.description: Lake County Health Department Lakes Management Unit samples Lake Michigan beaches four days a week during the beach season (May through September); public advisories and water-quality notices are posted.

boil order lifted for most round lake be.title: Boil order lifted for most Round Lake Beach residents
boil order lifted for most round lake be.description: Round Lake Beach reports a boil order was lifted for most residents after a vehicle struck a fire hydrant; the village website also lists upcoming events for March 2026.
